world.note: all link frames are parallel to world at home (all joints 0)

antenna.rod_note: M9 PLA antenna rods d 4.0 (were TPU d 2.4): print lying on the bed, 100 %, glued into 4.25 sockets; or a 4 mm wooden / carbon rod

constraints.why: deep bow and deep nod together put the head on the deck and J2 at its torque ceiling (CAD sampling)
constraints.exception: the named pose 'dock' (J1 = J3 = J4 = J6 = 0), checked on its own and along its approach path

list.name: dxl_opencr_p1
list.what: DYNAMIXEL TTL: OpenCR TTL port 1 (front edge, in front of the Pi) up, back over the Pi under the deck, up through the rear deck opening into the base servo's connector B (its notch faces the rear)
list.part: ROBOTIS Robot Cable-X3P 180 mm (one comes with each 2XL430)

list.name: dxl_p1_p2
list.what: DYNAMIXEL TTL: base servo connector A along its notch, out at the rear, up the spine hole and the bushing to the lower servo (daisy chain - replaces M10's 300 mm OpenCR -> P2 lead)
list.assumed: OpenCR TTL port position ASSUMED; crosses yaw and bow
list.part: ROBOTIS Robot Cable-X3P 180 mm (one comes with each 2XL430)

list.name: dxl_p2_p3
list.what: DYNAMIXEL TTL (X3P 180 mm): lower servo to upper servo, round the back
list.assumed: route ASSUMED; crosses twist and roll
list.part: ROBOTIS Robot Cable-X3P 180 mm (supplied with each servo)

list.name: dxl_p3_p4
list.what: DYNAMIXEL TTL (X3P 180 mm): upper servo to head servo, behind the neck
list.assumed: route ASSUMED; crosses nod and pan
list.part: ROBOTIS Robot Cable-X3P 180 mm (supplied with each servo)

list.name: usb_webcam
list.what: Adafruit Ultra Tiny USB Webcam (ada-5733) adapter cable: head, shoulder clip, turret, spine hole, along the rear of storey 2 behind the base servo, down into the up-angle USB-A adapter on the Pi's rear USB stack
list.assumed: where the cable leaves the webcam and its length are UNKNOWN
list.part: Integrated captive USB-A cable on ada-5733 (2.1 mm OD)

list.name: uart_display
list.what: Waveshare 1.9inch LCD SPI: the supplied MX1.25 8-pin cable (20 cm, female jumpers) + 8 male-female jumpers 30 cm, through the cradle plate, the shoulder clip (the jumper joint sits there), turret and spine hole to Pi pins 17-24 and pin 12 (backlight)
list.assumed: route ASSUMED; that the board runs from 5 V on VSYS is read off the maker's pin diagram, NOT tested; the display is not bought; its firmware is NOT written
list.part: Waveshare MX1.25 8PIN cable (supplied) + 8 x male-female 2.54 jumper wire 30 cm - no soldering

list.name: usb_opencr_pi
list.what: USB: OpenCR micro-USB (right edge, under the Pi's USB end) to the Pi's front USB stack, lower port
list.part: USB 2.0 cable, 90-deg micro-B (cable UP) to 90-deg USB-A (cable to the robot's FRONT), the shortest sold (10-15 cm); the spare length lies as a loop in the right-front bay

list.name: pi_power
list.what: 5 V from the OpenCR (max 4 A) up the left wall, over the deck, down onto the Pi's GPIO 5 V pins (bypasses the Pi's input fuse)
list.assumed: the mating plug for the 5267-02A header is to be bought; the lead bends 90 degrees within 6 mm above its plug, under the Pi
list.part: 2-wire lead to make (22 AWG): Molex 5264-02 housing (mates the OpenCR's 5267-02A 5 V header) to a 1 x 3 2.54 mm crimp housing on Pi pins 2-4-6 (5 V, 5 V, GND)

list.name: power_pigtail
list.what: LiPo (+) lead, 14 AWG red: OpenCR battery header up through the deck hole to the XT60 in the sled's pocket
list.part: 14 AWG red silicone wire + XT60 (to the pack) + the OpenCR battery plug (type to confirm on the board)
list.assumed: the battery connector's type is NOT stated in the e-Manual - to confirm on the board

list.name: power_pigtail_neg
list.what: LiPo (-) lead, 14 AWG black: as the red one

notes: Revision intent: mech_M12_screws with the solderless Waveshare 1.9inch LCD (its own STEP, screwed from behind into its brass studs, supplied plug cable + jumpers), HGU and SIRLab on the same badge plate, and bought hardware (plugs, battery, XT60, standoffs, screws) drawn as it looks.
Inactive axes: P1.B (hypothesis ID 1) and P4.A (hypothesis ID 8) drive nothing and must not be commanded. With torque OFF they are free to spin but carry no load in this topology.
Joint sign: positive = direction of an increasing DYNAMIXEL position (CCW seen facing the horn, per e-Manual convention) - NOT verified on hardware.
The STEP does not model the output shaft; horn/idler meshes are excluded from collision proxies.
Electronics and camera are ENVELOPES with PRELIMINARY (UNMEASURED) sizes and assumed masses.
Printed-part masses assume PLA 1.24 g/cc at the stated fill (ASSUMPTION until weighed).
